# Puzzle Jar

> Puzzle Jar is a free iPhone and Android app with 20 shape-and-colour puzzle games in one place: unscrew bolts, sort nuts and sweets, match buttons, untangle strings of lights, pop bubbles and more, all playable offline. Made by Sultan of Niyyat.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6823780719
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sultanofniyyat.arrowrush.game

## Pages

- [Puzzle Jar: 20 puzzle games in one free app](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/): Puzzle Jar puts 20 calm shape-and-color puzzle games in one free iPhone and Android app. Plays offline, no account. Rules, tips and honest answers.
- [Bolts & Jars: the screw puzzle](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/bolts-and-jars-screw-puzzle/): How the Bolts & Jars screw puzzle works, how to win and lose, and tips for hard levels, from the team that made Puzzle Jar.
- [Sweet Stacks: the color sort puzzle](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/sweet-stacks-color-sort/): Rules, strategy and helpers for Sweet Stacks, the ball-sort style color sort in Puzzle Jar: wrapped sweets, free undo, +1 jar and how to get unstuck.
- [Button Tin: the triple tile match](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/button-tin-tile-match/): How Button Tin, the triple tile match in Puzzle Jar, works: free and shaded buttons, the 7-space card, face-down buttons, tips for a full card, and the helpers.
- [Nut Sort: the nuts and bolts sort puzzle](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/nut-sort-nuts-and-bolts/): How Nut Sort works in Puzzle Jar: tall and short bolts, caps, dark nuts, tips for tricky boards, the +1 Bolt rescue, and how it differs from Bolts & Jars.
- [Bead Swap: the match-3 game](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/bead-swap-match-3/): Bead Swap rules, what the needle, burst and rainbow beads do, how to beat wax, crates and buttons, and why levels are never rigged. By the makers of Puzzle Jar.
- [Mosaic Tray: the block puzzle](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/mosaic-tray-block-puzzle/): How Mosaic Tray works: placing pieces, clearing rows and columns, collecting jewels, and why every hand of pieces can be placed. From the Puzzle Jar team.
- [Toy Chest: the color block jam](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/toy-chest-block-jam/): Toy Chest rules: sliding blocks out through doors of their color, moves, stones, two-color blocks, ice, one-way blocks and locks. No clock. By the Puzzle Jar team.
- [Hop On: the bus jam puzzle](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/hop-on-bus-jam-puzzle/): How Hop On works: tapping passengers to the bus, the bench, hidden and frozen passengers, doorways, and how to keep the bench from filling up. No clock.
- [Pencil Case: the tap-away puzzle](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/pencil-case-tap-away-puzzle/): How Pencil Case works: which way pencils slide, why you lose hearts, what clips and erasers do, and how to clear hard cases. From the team behind Puzzle Jar.
- [Snug Skeins: the yarn unwind puzzle](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/snug-skeins-yarn-sort/): How Snug Skeins works: unwinding wool from felt toys into baskets, the sewing tin, tied, pinned and hidden-wool toys, and tips to keep the tin clear.
- [Shelf Sort: the goods sorting game](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/shelf-sort-goods-sorting/): How Shelf Sort works: moving goods between shelves, three alike pop, rows behind, locked and picky shelves, and why there is no timer. From the Puzzle Jar team.
- [Treat Drop: the drop and merge game](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/treat-drop-merge-game/): How Treat Drop works: aiming and dropping sweets, the ten sizes from sprinkle to rainbow lolly, goals, the dotted line, and tips for a tidy jar.
- [Honey Hive: the hexa sort puzzle](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/honey-hive-hexa-sort/): How Honey Hive's hexagon stacks merge, how to collect 10 of a color, why the comb fills up, and tips for hard levels, from the team that made it.
- [Fruit Tumble: the tap-to-blast fruit game](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/fruit-tumble-tap-to-blast/): Fruit Tumble rules, the fizz rocket, coconut and blender, ice, jam jars and nets, and how it differs from Balloon Bunch and Tide Pool.
- [Balloon Bunch: the floating balloon pop game](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/balloon-bunch-pop-game/): How Balloon Bunch works: balloons that float up, fireworks that join together, clouds and tied balloons, and tips for running out of moves.
- [Tide Pool: the rising-rows blast puzzle](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/tide-pool-blast-puzzle/): How Tide Pool works: pop sea creatures, watch the tide push rows up every few taps, make waves, and keep the pool from overflowing.
- [Garland Tangle: the untangle puzzle](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/garland-tangle-rope-untangle/): How to untangle the strings of lights in Garland Tangle: moving lanterns between posts, nailed lanterns, move limits and tips for hard boards.
- [Bubble Picnic: the bubble shooter](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/bubble-picnic-bubble-shooter/): How to aim and bank shots in Bubble Picnic, how the swap and rainbow bubble work, stars and stone bubbles, and tips to save bubbles.
- [Quilt Pins: the patchwork logic puzzle](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/quilt-pins-logic-puzzle/): Quilt Pins rules: one pin in every patch, row and column, and no touching pins. Solving tips, hearts, hints and how the quilts get harder.
- [Route Duel: the route-clearing duel](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/route-duel-puzzle-duel/): How Route Duel works: take turns with a computer rival to clear routes off picture boards, score the most cells, and beat the clock in Solo Run.
- [Is Puzzle Jar free? Ads, purchases and prices](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/is-puzzle-jar-free/): Puzzle Jar is free to download and every level can be won without paying. When ads show, what Remove Ads does, and every price in the app.
- [Playing Puzzle Jar offline, with no wifi](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/offline-puzzle-games-no-wifi/): Every Puzzle Jar game, level and daily puzzle plays with no wifi or mobile data. What still needs internet, and how to get ready for a flight.
- [Stuck on a level: hints, take backs, rescues and difficulty](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/stuck-hints-and-difficulty/): How hints, take backs and rescues work in Puzzle Jar, how hard levels get, how the game adjusts to you, and what to do on a level that feels impossible.
- [Kids, families, safety and privacy](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/kids-safety-and-privacy/): Puzzle Jar's age ratings, ads and purchases, what data is collected and by whom, and the store settings that stop a child buying by accident.
- [Help: phones, progress, settings and support](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/help/): Which phones run Puzzle Jar, how progress is saved, what to do if the app crashes or a purchase fails, the settings, and how to reach us.
- [The best puzzle games for your situation](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/best-puzzle-games/): Honest picks for offline, no-timer, ad-free, cozy, senior-friendly and flight-friendly puzzle games on iPhone and Android, including where Puzzle Jar fits.
- [Games like the puzzle games you already play](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/games-like-popular-puzzle-games/): If you like Screw Jam, Nut Sort, Candy Crush, Block Blast, Hexa Sort, Bus Jam or Queens, here are similar games, from Puzzle Jar and other studios.
- [Puzzle game types explained](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/puzzle-game-types-explained/): What screw puzzles, nut sort, tile match, hexa sort, bus jam and other phone puzzle genres are, plus what research says about puzzles and your brain.
- [About Puzzle Jar and the people who make it](https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/about/): Who makes Puzzle Jar, why it holds 20 games, how we test every level, why there are ads, and how to reach us with a bug, an idea or a press question.
